scope: Independent rotating-Kerr emitting-crossing and fixed impact-plane detector diagnostic; no inverse training, not full image acquisition, not old map repair

geometry.observer: static Boyer-Lindquist observer; finite-radius redshift included
geometry.source: prograde circular timelike emitter, r between 6 and 20
geometry.screen_coordinates: Bardeen impact-parameter labels used as a declared integration plane, not exact finite-distance telescope angles

chart.ray_branch: accessible simple exterior scattering turn; target crossing on outgoing backward leg
chart.jacobian: abs(d(alpha,beta)/d(lambda,z)); retained in every signal and pixel area
chart.selection: geometry-only scout completed before this freeze; no surrogate outcomes inspected

solver.B: separated polar-phase and regularized radial quadratures with scalar root inversion
solver.A: independent compactified-radius/polar second-order ODE plus equator events; does not use radial roots or analytic crossing times
solver.shared: metric/constants and final circular redshift formula; not independent GR theory

models.data_network: two-input two-hidden-layer tanh 32, outputs scaled r_source,phi_source,T
models.physics_network: same hidden widths scalar bounded r_source; residual J(r_source)=s_order-J_observer at 17x17 collocations; derive phi and T by exact specified quadratures
models.frozen_surrogate: tensor cubic spline on 33x33 network-evaluated knots; stored coefficients and axes; independent evaluation after freezing

detector.pixel_definition: same fixed chart rectangles mapped to curved impact-plane pixels
detector.noise_variance: sigma^2 times full fixed pixel area
detector.fields: g^3 times [1,cos(2pi(t-T)/20),sin(2pi(t-T)/20),cos(2pi(t-T)/40),sin(2pi(t-T)/40),(r-10)/10,cos(phi),sin(phi)] at each observer time
detector.primary: maximum per-channel relative whitened detector vector error
detector.zero_norm_rule: relative undefined if reference norm is zero, report absolute; no passed undefined channel
detector.qualification: numerical comparison on this patch and source diagnostic family, not rigorous uniform continuum certificate

verification.sampled_a_posteriori: compare PINN radial integral residual with actual heldout radius/time error; conditional monotonic residual bound; no global interval certificate
verification.freeze_conversion: same detector compare native neural model against its frozen spline
verification.out_of_chart: refuse rather than extrapolate or blank light

budget.training_residual_evaluations: count separately incl repeated quadrature; not free and not independent truth rays

registration: geometry scout and source debugging precede this experiment registration, both retained; protocol and source hashes frozen before calibration/model fitting/detector outcomes
